messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: RIDER-OPS triggered by service `redwood-api` (route: /v1/generate). Severity: P1. count=18 in 2m. Pager: eng-oncall.

jared: seeing the PD page, joining. I can confirm increased 5xx rate from canary at rollout v2026.03.15-rc3.

carla: @jared thanks — do we know request path? metric shows spike across text-gen and embeddings.

jared: it's primarily text-gen. p95 latency up too. Canary nodes (eu-west-1) show elevated GPU mem reclaim logs.

lee: adding logs: ```
# tail -n 40 /var/log/containers/serving-canary-rc3.log
OOM handler: reclaiming kv cache
kernel: killed process qkv_runner
```

maria: I see service tag v2026.03.15-rc3 in the deployment controller. Who kicked the rollout? @sam?

sam: yeah that rollout started ~ 08:42 UTC, automated canary 20%. I rolled forward because smoke passed.

carla: ok first step: abort further traffic shifts and route traffic off canary. Can we throttle the rollout?

jared: doing traffic pause now. `kubectl -n serving set traffic rollout rc3 --to baseline` (running)

IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: Traffic shift command executed by jared. Canary traffic set to 0%. Autoretry disabled.

lee: still seeing 5xx on existing canary pods for next 30s - must be pods still terminating. Starting mitigation: scale down canary deploy to 0 and drain pods.

maria: customer impact? any ongoing customer-facing errors reported? Support thread shows a handful of customers seeing generation errors (IDs: C-1123, C-1127). Ticket volume low but correlated.

carla: classify as partial impact to a subset of EU customers. Escalating severity: P1 -> P0? I think P1 is fine since mitigation in progress, but PD on-call should stay engaged.

sam: quick root check — rc3 introduced a quantization change to the attention kernel and a new memory accounting flag. Could be regressing kv cache usage.

jared: agree. propose: rollback rc3, then run a repro on a dev rig with the quant change toggled off. Approval?

lee: +1 rollback. I'll prepare rollback job. Command: ``kubectl rollout undo deploy/serving-rc3 -n serving``

IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: RIDER-OPS acknowledged by jared.

carla: while rollback runs, switch read-only routes to baseline and enable autoscale headroom on baseline nodes. 

jared: rollback in progress. Logs: ``Rolling back to v2026.03.14-stable... rollout paused -> terminating rc3 pods``

sam: once rollback completes, I'll trigger a repro harness against a copy of the canary config with quant flag off. Need someone to collect heap profiles from failed pods. @lee?

lee: on it. grabbing pprof snapshots and `nvidia-smi` dumps, attaching to thread when done.

maria: letting support know we mitigated to baseline; drafting status update for affected customers: brief, apologetic, mention rollback and investigation.

IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: Rollback completed at 08:49:35 UTC. Baseline stable. 5xx rate dropping toward normal.

carla: status: impact reducing, tickets triaged, rollback success. Next: postmortem + repro. I volunteer to lead incident writeup.

jared: thanks. handoff: I'm on for 30m to validate no regressions post-rollback, then @maria picks up follow-up comms. Oncall rotation bot: @oncall-rotation-bot please note handoff in case of reopen.

oncall-rotation-bot: Handoff recorded: jared -> maria at 09:15 UTC. Reminder set for 1h to check metrics.

sam: saved artifacts: pprof, logs, deploy manifest, quant flag diff. Uploading to /shared/incidents/1765432100/ now.

lee: attached GPU logs and core dumps to the folder. Will run isolated repro with quant flag off and report back.

carla: great. closing PD incident? keep thread for postmortem notes. If anything reappears, we'll reopen PD.

jared: closing PD now. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

IncidentBot: PagerDuty: RIDER-OPS resolved by jared.

maria: quick action items captured: 1) repro + fix quant kernel memory accounting 2) add canary mem threshold alert 3) add automatic traffic cutoff when OOMs detected 4) customer comms draft. I'll create tickets and link here.

carla: +1. meeting to triage tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

sam: leaving final note: disable aggressive quant flag in release pipeline until confirmed on longer soak.

lee: logging note for postmortem: pod-level KV cache eviction patterns and kernel OOM traces attached.

jared: good work. thread archived for now.
